prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning (beds) or spray/sunless tanning? I can recommend different salons depending on which you want.

I don’t have live internet access to look up current local ratings, but here’s a quick way to find the best tanning salon in Tyler plus safety/quality criteria so you pick a good one — or paste a few names you find and I’ll help compare them.

How to find the best salon
- Search Google Maps, Yelp, or Facebook for “tanning salon Tyler TX” and sort by rating and number of reviews. Prefer places with 4.0+ stars and many reviews.
- Check recent customer comments for cleanliness, friendly staff, and whether equipment is well maintained.
- Look for salons that display bed age/brand (newer beds and well-known brands are safer/more effective) and offer a range of intensities.
- If you want spray tans: look for trained technicians, pictures of before/after results, and use of reputable solutions (bronzer vs. DHA-only).
- Visit in person if possible: inspect cleanliness, ask about technician training, and make sure eye protection and disposable underwear are provided for spray tans.

Quality indicators
- Modern equipment and good ventilation for bed tanning.
- Staff who build gradual tanning plans based on your skin type.
- Clear pricing and membership options.
- Visible sanitation procedures and single-use consumables for spray/tanning salons.
- Salon follows local regulations and posts exposure recommendations.

Safety reminders
- UV tanning increases risk of skin cancer and premature aging. Consider sunless spray if you want lower risk.
- Never exceed recommended exposure times; always use protective eyewear in beds.
- If you have fair skin, personal or family history of skin cancer, or take photosensitizing medications, avoid UV tanning and ask a doctor.

If you tell me “UV” or “spray,” and give a zip code or part of Tyler you’re near (e.g., South Tyler, near UT Tyler, near Broadway), I’ll suggest how to narrow to the top 2–4 salons and help evaluate the options you find.
